scope: Africa, Americas and Oceania expansion. Confirmed 2026 programmes, fixed annual national/cultural observances and explicitly undated seasonal watchlists are distinguished. This is not an exhaustive list of every local event. Historical travel evidence is not a November/December 2026 forecast.

events.title: Carnival Calabar
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Cross River State festival organiser
events.description: Calabar's main carnival programme features cultural performances, children's events and the parade of competing bands; the official schedule puts the band parade on December 28.

events.title: Lamu Yoga & Wellbeing Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser
events.description: Lamu Island hosts five days of yoga, wellbeing sessions and community experiences, based around Shela Beach.

events.title: Dak’Art — Biennale of Contemporary African Art
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by official biennale organiser
events.description: Dakar hosts exhibitions, design, performances and artistic dialogue, with associated activity in Senegal's regions and diaspora. Principal venues include the former Law Courts and National Art Gallery.

events.title: December in GH cultural season
events.dateStatus: 2026 December calendar launched by tourism ministry and GTA; individual dates vary
events.description: Ghana's official December programme brings together cultural, food, music and diaspora events. Consult the individual organiser for each listing.

events.title: KIDDAFEST at the National Theatre
events.dateStatus: 2026 listed in tourism ministry and GTA calendar
events.description: The National Theatre hosts the children's cultural celebration listed in Ghana's official seasonal programme.

events.title: BHIM Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 listed in tourism ministry and GTA calendar
events.description: The University of Ghana Sports Stadium hosts this music event during the December cultural season.

events.title: Zumaland Music & Art Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser
events.description: Borteyman in Accra hosts a two-day programme of music, visual art, food and cultural performance.

events.title: Detty December Sierra Leone
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by festival organiser; individual programme varies
events.description: Freetown's diaspora-focused festive season includes concerts, beach events and cultural gatherings. Some individual functions are private or separately ticketed.

events.title: Cairo International Film Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by festival organiser
events.description: The 47 th Cairo International Film Festival brings international cinema, screenings and industry activity to Egypt's capital.

events.title: Great Ethiopian Run International 10 km
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser registration page
events.description: Addis Ababa's large community road race combines elite running with a colourful mass-participation celebration; surrounding weekend activities have separate schedules.

events.title: International Festival of the Sahara, Douz
events.dateStatus: Annual late-December festival documented by national tourism board; exact 2026 programme unverified
events.description: Douz celebrates nomadic desert heritage through traditional performances and equestrian and camel culture. Do not substitute dates from a previous edition for the 2026 schedule.

events.title: Nyege Nyege Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser
events.description: Kalagala Falls near Jinja hosts a multi-stage gathering of African and international music, art and film. The organiser specifies an adults-only event.

events.title: Ngondo — main Sawa water-oracle ceremony
events.dateStatus: Calculated from UNESCO-documented annual first-Sunday-of-December tradition; local 2026 programme to confirm
events.description: The Sawa communities gather beside the Wouri River in Douala for Ngondo's sacred canoe ceremony, following a season of public cultural activities. Respect the distinction between public and sacred practices.

events.title: Incwala / First Fruits ceremony
events.dateStatus: Annual year-end ceremony; dates depend on traditional lunar calculations and await official confirmation
events.description: Eswatini's sacred royal ceremony marks renewal and the first fruits of the harvest. Dates are announced close to the event; participation and photography follow traditional protocols.

events.title: International Kreol Festival — seasonal watchlist
events.dateStatus: Previous December editions documented by official destination publisher; 2026 dates not confirmed
events.description: Mauritius celebrates Kreol music, language and cultural identity through its international festival. The linked destination report concerns a previous edition, so use it for context while awaiting the 2026 programme.

events.title: National Kenu & Kundu Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by national tourism authority
events.description: Alotau in Milne Bay hosts traditional canoe racing, kundu drumming, sing-sings, crafts and performances celebrating maritime cultures.

events.title: Christmas at Home, Apia
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Samoa Tourism Authority event listing
events.description: The celebration in front of the Government Building brings Christmas parade activity, tree lighting, government carols and a youth Christmas concert; confirm timings for each component.

events.title: President’s Day
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Republic of the Marshall Islands Public Service Commission
events.description: A national commemoration in the Marshall Islands. Specific public ceremonies and visitor access require local confirmation.

events.title: Gospel Day
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Republic of the Marshall Islands Public Service Commission
events.description: The national Gospel Day observance falls on the first Friday of December. Community and church programmes are separately organised.

events.title: FSM Independence / National Day
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual national observance; local 2026 programme unverified
events.description: The Federated States of Micronesia commemorate the Compact and end of UN trusteeship.

events.title: Family Day
events.dateStatus: 2026 date listed by Australian Embassy in Palau; individual programmes unverified
events.description: Palau's national family holiday is a community and family observance rather than a single ticketed festival.

events.title: Christmas / Kilisimasi
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual religious observance and statutory holiday; 2026 local programmes unverified
events.description: Tuvalu's statutory Christmas observance is on December 25. No separate nationwide 2026 festival programme is asserted.

events.title: Christmas Day observance
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual religious observance; linked government notice documents 2025, not 2026 closure arrangements
events.description: Christmas is a recognised national religious celebration in Nauru. The coming year's detailed community programme and public-service closure notice are not verified here.

events.title: Christmas Day observance
events.dateStatus: Fixed religious observance; 2026 government closure notice not verified
events.description: Kiribati's public-service calendar recognises Christmas on December 25. The linked official calendar is for 2025; no unverified 2026 festival programme is implied.

events.title: National Unity Day
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual statutory date; observed day and 2026 ceremonies to confirm locally
events.description: Vanuatu's National Unity Day is a civic observance on November 29; the statutory substitute-day rule may affect business closures.

events.title: Stanley Christmas Tree Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Falkland Islands Tourist Board

events.title: Stanley Sports Race Meeting

events.title: Christmas Carols under the Whalebone Arch
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Falkland Islands Tourist Board

events.title: Proclamation of Independence Day

events.title: Boxing Day Junkanoo, Nassau
events.dateStatus: 2026 winter season confirmed by destination promotion board
events.description: Downtown Nassau's Junkanoo parade showcases elaborate costumes, music and dance on Boxing Day. The separate New Year's parade takes place January 1.

events.title: Pirates Week — Grand Cayman
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Cayman Islands official tourism calendar
events.description: Grand Cayman's national festival combines pirate spectacles, heritage activities, food and community celebrations. Other islands have separate dates.

events.title: Gimistory — International Storytelling Festival
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by Cayman Islands official tourism calendar
events.description: Cayman's storytelling festival brings oral performance and cultural gatherings to the island community; consult the programme for individual venues.

events.title: Festival of Light / Saint Lucia Day season
events.dateStatus: Annual tradition: festival on eve of December 13 Saint Lucia Day; exact 2026 programme unverified
events.description: Lantern making, a parade, cultural performance and festive lighting culminate around Saint Lucia Day in Castries. The linked cultural foundation distinguishes the eve's festival from the December 13 observance.

events.title: Nine Mornings Festival
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual festival window; individual 2026 community schedules to confirm
events.description: Saint Vincent's distinctive pre-dawn Christmas celebrations bring entertainment, church gatherings and community activities across nine mornings.

events.title: Carriacou Parang Festival
events.dateStatus: Annual Christmas-season festival documented by tourism authority; exact 2026 dates unverified
events.description: Carriacou's bands combine Christmas carols with humorous musical accounts of the year's happenings, accompanied by traditional instruments and cultural performance.

events.title: Antigua and Barbuda Art Week
events.dateStatus: 2026 dates confirmed by current national tourism website; supersedes older printed dates
events.description: Art Week celebrates contemporary creativity through exhibitions, studio visits, workshops, fashion and live performance across the destination.

events.title: Sugar Mas — National Carnival
events.dateStatus: Annual December-to-January carnival; exact 2026–27 dates not confirmed in reviewed organiser pages
events.description: Saint Kitts and Nevis's national carnival unites folklore, music and masquerade during the year-end season. Do not reuse the organiser's older December 2025–January 2026 dates.

events.title: Dande Festival
events.dateStatus: Annual late-December tradition; exact 2026 contest dates to confirm
events.description: Aruba's traditional musical competition celebrates Dande songs of goodwill for the New Year. Older tourism material gives December 27, while past editions have varied.

events.title: Reggae Marathon — Half Marathon, 10 K & 5 K
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser; race day December 6

events.title: Giant Kite Festival / Barriletes Gigantes
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual cultural tradition; 2026 local programme to confirm
events.description: Santiago Sacatepéquez and Sumpango display giant ceremonial kites on All Saints' Day, connecting community art with remembrance of the dead.

events.title: Garifuna Settlement Day
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual cultural commemoration; local programme varies
events.description: Garifuna communities celebrate their heritage with the dawn arrival re-enactment, drumming, music, food and cultural gatherings, particularly in Dangriga and southern Belize.

events.title: Carnaval de San Miguel
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by national tourism calendar
events.description: San Miguel's major carnival finale brings floats, music and street celebrations, following neighbourhood festivities throughout November.

events.title: La Purísima and La Gritería
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual novena and feast; La Gritería is December 7, local schedules vary
events.description: Nicaragua's Marian celebration brings decorated altars, prayer and singing. La Gritería on December 7 is the central public tradition before the December 8 feast.

events.title: Art Basel Miami Beach
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser; VIP previews December 2–3
events.description: The Miami Beach Convention Center hosts the international modern and contemporary art fair, alongside the broader Miami Art Week programme.

events.title: Natal Luz de Gramado
events.dateStatus: 2026–27 dates confirmed by Rio Grande do Sul government tourism listing
events.description: Gramado's Christmas season combines staged musical spectacles, parades and festive attractions; each production has its own performance calendar and ticketing.

events.title: Santurantikuy artisan fair, Cusco
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual fair date documented by municipal organiser; 2026 arrangements to confirm
events.description: Cusco's Plaza de Armas hosts a major traditional Christmas artisan fair, known for Niño Manuelito figures, nativity objects and regional craft techniques.

events.title: Virgen de Caacupé pilgrimage and feast
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual religious feast; pilgrimage activity begins beforehand
events.description: Pilgrims gather at the Caacupé sanctuary for Paraguay's major Marian feast. The December 8 date is fixed, while transport controls and ceremony details are announced separately.

events.title: Mama Negra — November civic celebration

events.description: Latacunga's emblematic civic-cultural procession combines community characters, music and religious traditions. Its November edition is distinct from the September observance.

events.title: Fiesta Grande de la Virgen de Andacollo

events.description: Oaxaca's horticultural and artisan tradition transforms radishes into elaborate festive scenes and figures for a distinctive Christmas-season celebration.

US.label: Historical annual overseas visitor source markets and resident outbound context
US.note: Inbound list is the five leading OVERSEAS air-visitor markets from NTTO SIAT, excluding Canada and Mexico; it must not be presented as the top five among all US visitors. Outbound countries retain the separate NTTO annual outbound record. These are historical annual definitions, not Nov/Dec 2026 rankings.

11.label: Historical same-month visitor source markets and leading outbound country
11.note: NTTO actual November 2024 international visitor arrivals, including Canada and Mexico. Outbound list contains ONLY the verified leading country, Mexico, not a complete country ranking. All figures count historical movements, not unique people or 2026 demand.

12.label: Historical same-month visitor source markets and leading outbound country
12.note: NTTO actual December 2024 international visitor arrivals, including Canada and Mexico. Outbound list contains ONLY the verified leading country, Mexico, not a complete country ranking. All figures count historical movements, not unique people or 2026 demand.

MU.label: Historical annual tourist origins and resident departure disembarkation countries
MU.note: Inbound arrivals are by country of residence (Statistics Mauritius). Outbound table 5 of the Ministry of Tourism 2024 handbook ranks resident departures by COUNTRY OF DISEMBARKATION: UAE 85131, Reunion 43625, India 39354, France 35884, South Africa 28854, UK 25294. A disembarkation country may be a transit point, not the final destination; departures are not unique people or tourism-only trips. Both are historical 2024 evidence, not a 2026 month forecast.

11.label: Historical same-month inbound source markets
11.note: Computed ranking from Ministry of Tourism Handbook 2024 table 12, all tourists by country of residence. This is actual November 2024 context, not measured November 2026 demand.

12.label: Historical same-month inbound source markets
12.note: Computed ranking from Ministry of Tourism Handbook 2024 table 12, all tourists by country of residence. This is actual December 2024 context, not measured December 2026 demand.

KE.label: Historical annual international visitor source markets
KE.note: Tourism Research Institute report ranks the US first, Uganda second and Tanzania third, followed by UK. The list records arrivals, not unique travellers, and does not forecast a November/December 2026 month.

BR.period: 2024 calendar year; official table presented November 2025
BR.label: Historical annual international arrivals by permanent residence
BR.note: The Ministry of Tourism/Embratur/Federal Police table presented to Brazil's Chamber of Deputies gives this 2024 country order. Data are annual and may be revised; not month-specific 2026 demand. No verified resident outbound country ranking included.

PE.label: Historical annual tourist arrivals by country of residence
PE.note: MINCETUR release identifies Chile 21.5%, US 18.6%, Ecuador 8.9%, Bolivia 5.8%, Brazil 5.7%, Colombia 5.2% of 2024 international tourist arrivals. Residence-based arrival counts; not future monthly demand.

FJ.label: Historical annual visitor arrival source markets
FJ.note: Fiji's tourism minister's Parliamentary answer identifies these country source markets; a further grouped category is Pacific Islands, which is not a country and is omitted here. Australia andNew Zealand together accounted for over 63% of arrivals. No resident outbound destination ranking verified.

NZ.period: Inbound:2024 calendar year; outbound:12 months to February 2024
NZ.label: Historical annual visitor arrivals and resident overseas-trip destinations
NZ.note: Inbound ordering is from Stats NZ's official 2024 release (syndicated by Publicnow). Outbound ordering is Infometrics' original analysis of Stats NZ data for a different annual window. Periods and definitions differ; do not compare counts as a common-year balance or forecastNov/Dec 2026.

ZA.label: Historical annual leading African visitor source markets
ZA.note: Wesgro's AU regional factsheet reports these three leading African source countries using SA Tourism data. This is a regional market view, not an exhaustive global ranking, and is not a Nov/Dec 2026 forecast.
